Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`).

## Fix

0.4.1 could not upgrade uv installs: its upgrade command passed `--refresh-package`, which `uv tool upgrade` rejects. 0.4.2 passes `--reinstall-package miseenplace-cli` instead, and a test now runs the real uv with the exact flags.

If you are on 0.4.1 with uv, upgrade once by hand: `uv tool upgrade --reinstall-package miseenplace-cli miseenplace-cli`. From 0.4.2 on, mep updates itself hourly.
